title: Admissible ambient extension Z of the normal variation ζν, with its tangential derivative
statement: Admissible ambient extension of a normal variation. Data: P ∈ ℕ; U, O, M, C ⊆ ℝ^P; ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P; ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ. Hypotheses: U and O are open; M ⊆ U and M ⊆ O; ν is C^∞ on O; |ν(x)| = 1 for x ∈ M; ζ is C^∞ on ℝ^P; C is compact, C ⊆ M, and ζ(x) = 0 for every x ∈ M ∖ C. Conclusion: there is a C^∞ map Z : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport Z ⊆ U such that (a) Z(x) = ζ(x)ν(x) for every x ∈ M; (b) DZ(x)τ = (Dζ(x)τ)ν(x) + ζ(x)Dν(x)τ for every x ∈ M and τ ∈ span(tangentSpace M x); (c) for every x ∈ M with x ∉ tsupport Z, ζ(x) = 0 and Dζ(x)τ = 0 for every τ ∈ span(tangentSpace M x). Here D = fderiv ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U O M C : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P) (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen U → IsOpen O → M ⊆ U → M ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O → (∀ x ∈ M, ‖ν x‖ = 1) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ → IsCompact C → C ⊆ M → (∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C → ζ x = 0) → ∃ Z : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Z ∧ HasCompactSupport Z ∧ tsupport Z ⊆ U ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, Z x = ζ x • ν x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, ∀ τ ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x), fderiv ℝ Z x τ = fderiv ℝ ζ x τ • ν x + ζ x • fderiv ℝ ν x τ) ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ tsupport Z → ζ x = 0 ∧ ∀ τ ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x), fderiv ℝ ζ x τ = 0)
